info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Loan Application By Document Id-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows authorized users to remove a specific document associated with a loan application using its unique identifiers. It is primarily designed for financial institutions and loan processing services that manage comprehensive loan documentation. Consumers can utilize this endpoint to maintain the integrity of loan files by deleting unnecessary or outdated documents, thereby ensuring compliance and efficient data management. Typical use cases include updating loan applications or responding to regulatory requirements. Access control is essential to safeguard sensitive loan documentation.

delete.description: This endpoint allows developers to delete a specific document associated with a loan application identified by the resource ID. Ensure that the document is no longer needed before deletion, as this action cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details for deleting a document associated with the loan application identified by RES-100045. The structure of the request must conform to the defined schema to ensure successful processing of the delete operation.

DeleteLoanApplicationByDocumentIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting a loan application document. The body should contain a string value.
